svg.data-vd-steps: [[0, "Evidence for evolution from sequences."], [1, "Align the sequences and count the differences."], [5, "Haemoglobin \u03b2-chain differences from humans."], [10.5, "Fewer differences = more recent common ancestor."]]
svg.title: Evidence from sequences
svg.desc: Aligned amino acid sequences with differences highlighted, and a bar chart of haemoglobin beta-chain differences from humans: gorilla 1, rhesus monkey 8, dog 15, horse 25, frog 67.
svg.text: Upper panel: an illustrative aligned stretch. Lower panel: lesson data.

g.data-info: Line up the base or amino acid sequences of the same gene or protein from different species and count the differences.
Differences from the human sequence: gorilla 1, rhesus monkey 8, dog 15, horse 25, frog 67.
g.text: haemoglobin β-chain: amino acid differences from humans

g.data-info: Fewer differences → more recent common ancestor → closer relationship. Differences accumulate gradually, so they act like a molecular clock.
